evals.name: Single pending entry
evals.prompt: Single pending entry — **Setup**: queue has one entry: `{"skill":"create-silver","date":"2026-05-23","correction":"used monotonically_increasing_id","pattern":"never monotonically_increasing_id for SCD2","status":"pending"}`.
evals.expected_output: Output of /developer-plugin:apply-learnings matching the SKILL.md phases for scenario Single pending entry
expectations: Reflects: "the correction was about SCD2 surrogate keys".
Abstracts: "non-determinism in surrogate keys breaks SCD2 idempotency".
Generalises: "NEVER use monotonically_increasing_id for SCD2 surrogate keys; use xxhash64 or row_number()".
Writes the rule into `developer-plugin/skills/create-silver/SKILL.md` § Active Learnings as `L-NNN`.
